items.title: Advance Commvault onboarding, compliance locks, and resource contracts
items.summary: Introduces the 2026-08-01-preview projection with a newer LiftrBase dependency, storage compliance-lock status and actions, optional company and activation details, removed cloud-account creation principals, and required protection-group and role-assignment members. SaaS activation removes saaSGuid and adds required saasGuid; no rename lineage is established. ARM templates establish CloudAccount PATCH and list roles and Storage state-changing actions; CloudAccounts.update moves from a custom PATCH model to ArmResourcePatchAsync. The supplied operation inventory maps three CloudAccount operations, not an exhaustive mapping of every changed declaration. Compatibility conclusions compare the July and August preview projections, not regressions to an unchanged version selector.

inferenceResults.rationale: The hunk adds an optional, read-visible complianceLockStatus property starting in v9_preview. It neither removes an existing declaration nor imposes a new caller input obligation; no additional breaking candidate is established.

The madeRequired decorators version the same three ProtectionGroupProperties optionality changes already covered by supplied deterministic SDK candidates. They introduce no distinct additional contract change; the read visibility is preserved and no extra request obligation is inferred.

The hunk adds version-gated Storage enableComplianceLock, disableComplianceLock, and refresh action declarations without removing an existing operation or changing an existing signature. New resource actions are additive; no unrelated mapped operation is invented.

The new preview selects LiftrBase.Versions.v3_preview instead of the prior dependency version. This request supplies no dependency contract deltas, mapped operations, or fact identities; additional propagated compatibility effects cannot be established from the version declaration alone.

RoleAssignment adds a versioned entities replacement with minItems(1); its known required-member SDK changes are already supplied candidates. This request has no mapped operation/fact evidence for the extra collection constraint, and compact REST facts elide the array schema. Do not invent an additional wire narrowing or generated-language validation effect.

ComplianceLockStatus is a newly added v9_preview union with named values and a string fallback. No existing union member or accepted value is removed; the hunk establishes an additive declaration, not an existing-contract incompatibility.

The two creation-principal removals are already represented by deterministic REST and SDK candidates. The remaining company and roleAssignmentsOnCcaCreate additions are optional and version-gated; no distinct additional required caller input is established by this hunk.

The augment typeChangedFrom statement preserves a historical update-parameter projection while its direct SDK parameter change is already supplied. The request provides no independent mapped wire evidence, and CloudAccounts_Update has an explicit unresolved AutoRest contract; no extra compatibility verdict is inferred.
